Welcome to

Aperture

A plain-language snapshot of public health data for every community in the United States.

  • Look up any place. 3,100+ counties, 2,300+ cities, every state and 22 regions.
  • Compare side by side. See where places differ, with a written summary of what stands out.
  • Follow the trends. See how each measure has changed over the years.
  • Check every number. Each value links back to the public dataset it came from.

Like a camera, you control the scope: open it wide to regions and states, or focus in on counties and cities.

Free, no sign-up. Data from 20 public datasets (CDC, HHS, CMS, HRSA, Census, County Health Rankings). Not medical advice.
